From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Exec Leadership <leadership@redwood.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly exec priorities: wins, risks, asks — QBR input

Team —

Quick weekly pulse ahead of QBR prep. Please add brief, factual bullets to the shared tracker (attached by Marissa later) or drop notes in the Drive link. High level below — one-liners preferred.

Wins:
- Hosted API latency improved 12% for 512-token median after kernel swap (engineering).
- Two PLG pilots converted to paid (Acme Corp pilot -> $75k ARR).
- New Dedicated onboarding flow completed for 3 enterprise customers.

Risks / blocking items:
- Long-context evals show 1.6x tail latency for Llama-2-extended on a subset of workloads (affects some enterprise SLAs).
- Procurement delay for BetaCloud marketplace listing (legal review pending).
- One spec for Private deployment telemetry is behind schedule (SRE dependency).

Asks (this week):
1) Product/Eng: brief description of mitigation for long-context tail by EOD Thu (neha).
2) Sales/CS: impact note and renewal risk for Acme — quantify churn/expansion assumptions (laura).
3) GTM: suggested one-slide ask for QBR (price/discount guidance) — keep to a single bullet (marissa).

Attachments referenced: "QBR_input_tracker.xlsx" (Marissa will upload a working sheet)
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Inputs-2027

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
